kitText: Start of battle: steal 1 ATK from the strongest enemy
flavor: Will not let you be impressed with yourself.

name: Homework Checker
author: Kevin Wimer
kitText: Start of battle: the enemy front takes +1 damage per hit
flavor: Finds the missing work before the grades come in.

name: Cue
author: DBCrypto
kitText: Start of battle (front): the enemy front skips its next attack
flavor: Calls each cue on time. Flags a collision early.

name: Product Builder CoS
author: Sneha Ravindra
kitText: Armor 1: takes 1 less damage per hit
flavor: Turns each plan into a checklist, and keeps it.
